ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund to rider. No account action against the driver; optionally share the GPS/wait-time evidence with the rider to close the dispute.

rejected_claims.reason: GPS trace shows the driver was stationary within ~40 m of the pickup from 18:22:30 until the 18:26:40 cancellation — over 4 minutes, exceeding the 3-minute threshold in NS-1(iii); the 'I'm Here' press at 18:22:50 was inside the pickup radius.
Heavy rain creates no exemption under NS-1; a rider request for '2 more minutes' does not suspend the driver's right to cancel after >3 minutes of waiting at the pickup.
